pair.title: Add a virtual radar
pair.instructions: Select the source of the information. OpenSky is free but limited; new OpenSky accounts must use an API client (OAuth2 client credentials) while legacy accounts can still use username/password for now. Other services require an account.
pair.authMethodHint: New OpenSky accounts (mid-March 2025 and later) must use an API client. Older accounts can still use username/password for now.
pair.oauthMissing: Please enter your OpenSky API client ID and secret to use OAuth2.
pair.basicMissing: Please enter both username and password to use legacy authentication.

tab1.title: Instructions
tab1.addDeviceInstructions: Add a new device via the Homey tab `Devices`. Radar finds all aircraft in range of your Homey location. Tracker will track a single aircraft. Select the data source. OpenSky is free, but provides limited and sometimes inaccurate information.
